messages:
customer_john: Hey team — our canary rollout (cid=canary-981) has been stuck showing "In progress" in the Console for ~45m. Traffic switched but the health chart never moved past the spinning state. dashboard shows 0% progress, API /v1/rollouts/<canary-981> returns "status": "in_progress" repeatedly. Any idea?

sara_support: Sorry about that, John. Can you paste the rollout id and approximate time you kicked it off? Also are you seeing any errors in the API responses or just the console?

customer_john: rollout id: canary-981, kicked off at 2026-03-17T15:20Z. API responses are 200 but payload has "status": "in_progress" and no per-instance statuses in the metadata field. No obvious error body.

aj_p: @sara_support pinging eng-runtime — I can repro briefly in our staging if you want. Sound like the status-sync job didn't pick up the update event.

chris_runtime: looking. Which region? Could be the rollout-syncer queue got backed up or there's a deadlock on the status shard.

customer_john: region: us-west-2. We also noticed metrics for canary latency are present but the rollout health chart (progress) is empty.

lena_ml: quick question — did you use the console canary button or the API to initiate? UI vs API uses slightly different event wiring.

customer_john: API. We call POST /v1/rollouts with traffic rules.

aj_p: repro steps I used in staging: 1) POST rollout. 2) PATCH model-version after 10s. 3) Console shows spinner. curl shows status in_progress and no change to "progress_percent" key.

chris_runtime: I'm tailing rollout-syncer logs for us-west-2 now. If you can run this curl and paste result it helps:

```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/rollouts/canary-981 | jq '.'
```
customer_john: returned JSON (redacted):
```
{
  "id": "canary-981",
  "status": "in_progress",
  "progress_percent": null,
  "instances": []
}
```
chris_runtime: thanks. That matches what I'm seeing — the syncer never wrote instance statuses. I'm seeing repeated "acquire shard lease failed" warnings in the logs and then a rapid reconnect loop. Looks like the lease worker lost its DB advisory lock, then could not claim it because a long-running migration job held it.

aj_p: oh that explains it — migration was kicked earlier for an unrelated schema backfill in prod db-01 and it hogged the advisory lock. rollout-syncer is designed to wait but doesn't surface errors to the API, so Console keeps showing in_progress.

sara_support: Is there a safe workaround we can give the customer while eng fixes the lock situation?

chris_runtime: two options: 1) force-sync via admin endpoint to recompute statuses after we clear the migration lock. Endpoint: POST /internal/admin/rollouts/force-sync?region=us-west-2 body {"id":"canary-981"}. 2) Restart rollout-syncer pod for the region — that will attempt to reacquire the lock. Both are safe; prefer force-sync if you want minimal infra churn.

customer_john: we don't have access to internal admin endpoints. Can you run it for us?

lena_ml: running force-sync now.

oncall-bot: <deploy-bot> triggering job: admin.force-sync.rollouts us-west-2 for canary-981 — job id job-6543

lena_ml: job returned 200, started background reconcile. API now shows progress_percent=12, then 58, then 100. Console refreshed and the canary health chart populated.

customer_john: confirmed — chart updated and rollout completed. Thanks, team. Do you know root cause and when a permanent fix will be in place?

chris_runtime: root cause: advisory lock contention during a long schema backfill on prod db-01 caused rollout-syncer to repeatedly fail to claim shard leases. The syncer didn't elevate the error to the API layer, so the Console spinner never received an update.

aj_p: immediate mitigation: add a visibility timeout in the syncer and surface lease acquisition failures as a rollout status of "sync_delayed" (internal) so Console can show a clear state. Also schedule schema backfills with lower lock impact.

chris_runtime: created ticket INF-2321 to: 1) make syncer surface lease failures, 2) add admin metric for lease queue depth, 3) handle long-running migrations with lock timeouts. Owner: chris_runtime, reviewer: lena_ml. ETA: patch next week.

sara_support: Noted. I'll send a short postmortem to the customer and include the workaround (force-sync or restart). Also will add a KB article: "Console shows canary stuck in progress" with steps and links.

customer_john: appreciate that. For transparency can you add us to the incident update? We hit some SLA alerts.

sara_support: yes — adding you to the incident thread. Thanks for the fast turnaround. :thumbsup:

chris_runtime: follow-up: pushing a small change to log lease acquisition errors at ERROR level and to emit metric rollout_syncer.lease_acq_failures. I'll watch for any recurrences over the next 24h.

lena_ml: also adding an automated force-sync fallback after 3 failed lease attempts. That should reduce customer-visible downtime.

customer_john: all good. Closing on our side.

sara_support: Closing support thread; will link INF-2321 and KB once live.

oncall-bot: Incident INF-2321 created by chris_runtime — severity: P3, status: investigating.
